count.description: Number of events captured with this version in the last 7 days.

max_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the most recent event seen for this version (ISO 8601).

release_date.description: When this version was published on GitHub (ISO 8601), or null if unknown.

days_since_release.description: Days since this version was released, or null if unknown.

released_ago.description: Human-readable relative release age matching the UI (e.g. '5 months ago'). Null when release_date is unknown.

is_outdated.description: True when this version is flagged as outdated by smart-semver rules.

is_old.description: True when this version is flagged as old by age alone (separate from semver rules).

is_current_or_newer.description: True when this version equals or exceeds the latest known published version.

status_reason.description: Per-version badge tooltip text matching the SDK Doctor UI exactly. Quote verbatim when reporting to users. Varies by state: 'Released X ago. Upgrade recommended.' for outdated versions, 'You have the latest available. Click Releases above to check for any since.' for current versions, or 'Released X ago. Upgrading is a good idea, but it's not urgent yet.' for recent-but-behind versions.

sql_query.description: SQL SELECT statement for drilling into events for this SDK version over the last 7 days. Suitable to pass to the execute-sql tool or to display as a copy-paste snippet.

activity_page_url.description: Relative URL path (starting with /project/{id}/) for the Activity > Explore page pre-filtered to events captured with this lib and lib_version over the last 7 days. Combine with the user's PostHog host (e.g. us.posthog.com) for a clickable link.
